Subject: QwestPilot — VP/CIO demo window & delegation plan

Hi Aisha / Tim —

Thanks again for moving the QwestPilot demo forward. We want to make sure the right execs are present and that we have a clean fallback so the session stays productive if schedules shift. Proposal below:

- Primary demo: 60 minutes (45-minute product walkthrough, 15-minute deep-dive/Q&A)
- Two candidate windows (PT):
  • Option A: Dec 9, 2026 — 10:00–11:00 PT
  • Option B: Dec 10, 2026 — 16:00–17:00 PT
- Attendance ask: VP + CIO preferred. If either is only available for a portion, we’ll do the 45/15 split and arrange a handoff.
- Fallbacks: CTO or SVP of Eng may step in for the latter half; we’ll record the session and share notes.

I’m attaching a short preflight deck and a suggested delegate matrix to make decisions quick. Could you confirm:
1) Which window works for the VP and CIO?
2) Final attendee names & emails (so we send a calendar invite and dial-in).
3) Any specific topics you want emphasized during the 45-minute walkthrough (scaling, security, latency/cost)?

Attachments: [attachment: qwest-preflight-deck.pdf (PDF)], [attachment: delegate-matrix.xlsx (XLSX)]

If it helps, Ben can lead the technical deep-dive and Lauren will coordinate logistics and recording.

Thanks —
Priyom
